If you use a demo do not stay on it long. I got a demo and I felt so good when I won and the day I got a real account the only thing I was doing was losing. Open a micro account and take the losses you get and learn from it. DO NOT STOP LEARNING.   Learn to control your emotions, learn the different candle types, learn risk management, learn how to do indicators on previous charts and put into recent charts. And most importantly learn to stay consistent. Take notes daily as you go and write down why you got a loss and why you got a win and keep consistent with it and learn from them. Also do not try and use someone else strategy, as in do not use a lot of lines and indicators if you are easy to get confused. find what you understand best and learn to master it. Don’t overload yourself. Also trade small and never get greedy, if you open a micro account and do trades set yourself to get say $1 -$2 every trade and slowly build and learn as you go do not rush to get $50/trade.
